body:
Where the three pieces leave things: the account diagnosed a recording gap and proposed a record, a check-in, and a one-to-one. The objection and the rival, written independently, attack the same joint — the slide from a conjectural diagnosis to a remedy that presupposes it — and both draw the distinction the account blurred: between failing to reconstruct an agreement (the objection's 'memorial' case) and never having agreed to the same thing in the first place (the objection's 'normative' case; the rival's divergence at the moment of speaking). When two independent criticisms converge on one seam, I treat that seam as load-bearing and take the distinction up. I also take up the objection's clean version: the retrospective claim — agreements drifted because nothing was recorded — is plausible on the material; the prospective claim — record them and drift stops — is untested, and nothing should be built as if it were established.

The objection and the rival conflict with each other on one point, and it decides what to do first. The objection would reverse the ranking: engagement with the avoidance is load-bearing, the record optional. The rival argues the one-to-one about withdrawal may reproduce, at smaller scale, whatever the friend is withdrawing from, and proposes instead a uniform probe of all three flatmates. The material cannot decide between these orderings, but sequencing can do part of the work: the probe is informative under every live reading — memory gap, divergence-at-agreement, or standing-negotiation — while each rival first move presupposes a reading. The record presupposes the memory gap; naming the avoidance presupposes that avoidance is central. On that dominance argument I take up the probe as the first move and defer both rankings of the avoidance. I take up the rival's framing constraint alongside it: any individual conversation asks for the person's view of the group conversations, not their reasons for withdrawing — and the probe, asked identically of all three, already satisfies it.

The account's record survives only revised and demoted. If the probe returns conflicting but confident, stable reports of what was agreed, reconstruction failure is real and a record earns its place — but redesigned per the rival's criticism: not a ledger of who said what (which only arbitrates memory and, under the standing reading, relocates the argument onto the note), but a forcing device at the moment of agreement — scope, recurrence, deadline, and what done means, stated out loud and written. That is the one form in which a record addresses the normative dimension rather than merely the memorial one. The check-in survives thinly, as what the account itself described — the place where schedule changes get stated before they bite — which is useful under every reading, because the schedules change under every reading.

On the avoidance I accept neither available premise. The account says plausibly symptom; the objection says plausibly load-bearing; 'plausibly' is doing the work in both. The probe converts the avoider's behavior from premise into evidence: if they answer the neutral question much as the others do, private conversation is not the sticking point and the objection's reversal loses its ground; if they will not engage even there, the objection's ordering gains weight, and the next move is the rival's third-reading phrasing applied to the group — naming the pattern without blame, 'we keep having this conversation; what is it protecting?' — with the account's unranked mediator option behind it.

Since pre-registration is the objection's own demand, I will pin the update directions now. The objection's stated test direction reads inverted to me: it says that if a working record still leaves the arguments running, that supports the account; on my reading it would support the objection's own ranking, and the direction that counts against the objection is the record succeeding. Either way, the directions need stating before any trial. Mine: disagreements clustering on one dimension (scope, recurrence, or timing) → adopt the explicit scope-statement practice at the moment of agreement, no system; no cluster, with confident conflicting reports → the conditional, redesigned record; the probe blocked, or all three answers converging on 'the arguments are not about the chores' → the engagement-first branch above. A quiet week proves nothing either way — I adopt that from the objection and the account alike.

Concretely, then: this week, separately, in the same neutral wording — 'last time we agreed on a chore and later saw it differently, what did you think we had agreed to?' — and listen for which dimension the disagreement lives on, correcting nobody's recollection. One caveat the probe shares with the record it postpones: asking everyone privately makes the asker the keeper of three reports, which under the standing reading is just canvassing. Report themes, not attributions — or skip the probe entirely if you judge that even asking reads as taking sides, because that judgment cannot be made from here. My only expectation, stated so the probe can falsify it: the cluster, if there is one, lands on recurrence — one-off versus standing — since that is the dimension shifting schedules corrode.
commitments:
Taking this up means, first, two claim-type commitments, both contestable: that the reconstruction-versus-divergence distinction (the objection's memorial/normative split) is real enough to organize a first move around, and that the retrospective recording-gap claim is plausible while the prospective one is untested. The first softens if it turns out, as the objection itself allows, that the act of writing things down shifts norms in practice — in that case my branch structure loses sharpness and the redesigned record looks better than my ordering implies.

Second, my main structural claim — that the probe should precede both the record and any naming of the avoidance, because it is informative under every reading while the alternatives each presuppose one — stands or falls with the probe's actual costs. If asking the question reads as interrogation (the rival's own flag) or as private canvassing (my addition), the dominance argument collapses, and declining the probe on that ground is a rejection of my ordering, not a misuse of it. I am also committing to the three pre-declared branch directions as stated in the body: dimension-cluster to the scope-statement practice, confident conflict to the conditional record, blocked probe or chore-denying answers to engagement-first. If the objection's test direction was not inverted and I have misread it, the correction attaches to my reading of its text, not to the branches, which I would keep either way.

Third, application-type: the redesigned record — scope, recurrence, deadline, and done-means captured at the moment of agreement — is a conditional proposal, not a remedy I am recommending now. It inherits every risk already on the table: being read as surveillance (the account's flag), relocating the argument onto the artifact (the rival's), and formalizing a household that may want no formality. The thin check-in I kept is likewise a proposal; if it functions as one more chore, drop it.

What I am not committing to: either ranking of the avoidance as a premise; any claim about what the avoidance means, who bears what load, whether a mediator would help, or whether the household should formalize anything; and the recurrence-cluster expectation, which I hold weakly and which nothing downstream depends on. A probe finding of no cluster, or answers converging on 'this is not about chores,' should count against the whole recording family of readings — mine included — rather than be absorbed by them.

Unresolved and left open: the standing-negotiation reading is untouched by any branch and gains weight under non-clustering; whether the memorial/normative distinction is separable in practice; whether the avoiding friend will answer even a neutral question, which the probe itself tests; and the possibility that the probe surfaces an unequal baseline load, which none of the three inputs addresses and which could reorder everything above it.

If this continues, the work I am taking on is the probe's execution and honest report-back: what each flatmate actually said, including the avoider's non-answer, in their terms rather than mine, treating any single quiet week as uninformative and the pattern across the answers as the only evidence worth updating on.
